headline: Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ:SWKS) Exceeds Q2 Expectations But Stock Drops
summary: Wireless chips maker Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ: SWKS) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales fell by 3.1% year on year to $934.8 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $1.04 billion at the midpoint, 0.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.08 per share was 4.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Qorvo (NASDAQ:QRVO) Surprises With Strong Q2 But Stock Drops
summary: Communications chips maker Qorvo (NASDAQ: QRVO) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 4.2% year on year to $784.8 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.64 per share was 54.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
